title: ailanthus cacodendron var. sutchuenensis
intro: Ailanthus cacodendron var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as Chinese tree of heaven, is a deciduous tree native to China. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fever, and pain, as well as having antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Ailanthus cacodendron var. sutchuenensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
